go_rule: Every required gate must be passed for the same immutable release identity.

gates.evidence: Verify active PR head SHA immediately before final verification.
All blocker-specific regressions pass on exact head.
Lint, typecheck, and production build pass.
Generated and frozen cross-runtime release identity checks agree.
GitHub CI passes on the same exact head.
Independent reviewer has no unresolved release-blocking findings.
Fresh CodeRabbit review has no unresolved release-blocking findings.
Approved release identity deployed consistently to required production surfaces.
Same-SHA production acceptance matrix passes, including failure/limited/history/recovery boundaries.
Rollback path is proven and safe before final GO.
